name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Y'all talking about a career? We're talking about history. That Hollow Da Don battle? That was the crowning moment, pure and simple.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Y'all quantifying `momen' over twenty years.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Okay okay.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Twenty years? Tasha, that battle was the whole damn story! It wasn't just a moment, it was the coronation!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Or what? We crown him before the argument even starts?

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: We ain't crowning him, Tasha, we're placing the belt ON him! That's the main event!

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: TASHA RAW
line: And that 'main event' didn't close the argument either.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: She said it didn't close the argument? Bullshit! That fight's got legendary haymakers, man. The Seatbelt bar alone? That's a damn title defense!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Mmhm.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Still no consensus. You made your pick, Blaze.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: No consensus? That's a word for spreadsheets, not for heart, y'all!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Your heart doesn't prove it either, Blaze.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Okay okay okay, King, you wanna talk Ill Will? That battle had heart, sure, but Hollow? That was history, man. That was the face of the URL!

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Heart and history are not the same currency, Marcus. The 'Emmett Till' scheme is not just a moment...it's a masterclass. The question isn't about the biggest stage, it's about the sharpest blade.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Come ON.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Cemented or not? Bars are pages. His whole book's still open.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: A page can be turned. A masterclass gets studied. That second round? It's still in the curriculum.

name: TASHA RAW
line: The curriculum needs an update, King. That curriculum's from 2017. The record reads different now.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The record reads different, but the tape don't. That second round is a clear 2-1 victory, and the blade was never sharper.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Sharp blade. Whole chapter unwritten.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: A culmination requires a foundation. That foundation was laid with Ill Will, and the blueprint is still being used.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Foundation cracks when the original architect keeps building, King. He's past blueprints now.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: An architect builds on his own foundation. The second round against Ill Will is the load-bearing wall.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: King, that blueprint is a foundation, not the whole damn skyscraper! The Hollow battle? That's the penthouse suite where the champion lives!

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: A penthouse is a view. A foundation is what you stand on. The question is what holds the weight.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: What holds the weight is the crowd on their feet, King! That's the main event energy!

name: TASHA RAW
line: You heard the crowd once. Consensus was never built. COTY says more. Exhibit A.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: COTY is a popularity contest. The tape is the evidence. Against Ill Will, he was flawless.
